Note on "Last TSE/Customer Ticket Activity": where an account currently has open tickets, the date reflects the most recent comment on that account's active ticket queue (high confidence) — this is the TSE and/or customer commenting on Zendesk tickets, not the AE or SE. Where no tickets are open, the date reflects the most recent comment found in a capped ticket sample (up to 100–200 tickets) — the underlying ticket API does not guarantee recency ordering, so these are marked partial sample and may not reflect true latest activity. FOOTER_ZDORG_EXCEPTIONS_NOTE
Note on "Last AE/SE SFDC Update": no field for AE/SE activity (LastActivityDate, Chatter, notes) is currently synced from Salesforce into this system — every account shows "not synced" until the SFDC sync pipeline is extended to pull it. This is intentionally left blank rather than filled in with ticket-side dates.
Account list reflects accounts confirmed to have SE_FULL_NAME as Opp SE Primary, verified against direct SFDC review — see the data-quality warning below before trusting synced SE data blindly. Opportunity values reflect open Salesforce opportunities, pulled live at report time. Ticket counts are lifetime totals per Supportal customer health data.
